paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира разпределението на пробите данни по различни типове разсъждения. Хоризонталната ос показва седем категории: Математическо разсъждение, Общо разсъждение, Разсъждение за природни сцени, Физическо разсъждение, Логически пъзел, Химично разсъждение, като категориите са подредени в произволен ред. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Брой проби" и показва стойности от 10^0 до 10^4 с линейна скала. Най-високата стойност е горе вдясно  и е 7025, а най-ниската е в долния ляв ъгъл и е 49. Представителни стойности за другите стълби са както следва: Общо разсъждение с 1709, Разсъждение за природни сцени с 413, Физическо разсъждение със 232, Логически пъзел с 91. Няма групирани или наслагвани стълби, а всички те са с еднаква широчина и са визуално еднакви, без допълнителни бележки като засенчване или удебеляване.
model_annotations.Chinese: This bar chart displays the distribution of samples across various reasoning categories. The horizontal axis lists the categories, which are Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning. The vertical axis, labeled "Number of Samples", ranges from 10^2 to 10^4, with major ticks at 10^2, 10^3, and 10^4, and minor ticks at intervals of 10^2. The bars are light blue and display the following values: Mathematical Reasoning with approximately 7025 samples, General Reasoning with 1709 samples, Natural Scene Reasoning with 413 samples, Physical Reasoning with 232 samples, Logical Puzzle Reasoning with 91 samples, and Chemical Reasoning with 49 samples. The bars decrease in height from left to right, with no apparent grouping or stacking, and no specific sorting or visual emphasis is applied to the categories.
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the distribution of samples across various reasoning categories. The horizontal axis lists the categories, which are labeled as Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of Samples" and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^2 to 10^4. Each category is represented by a light blue bar, with the height of the bar corresponding to the number of samples. The values range from 49 for Chemical Reasoning to 7025 for Mathematical Reasoning. The bars are arranged in descending order of height, with the tallest bar (Mathematical Reasoning) having a value of 7025 and the shortest bar (Chemical Reasoning) having a value of 49. The other bars have values of 1709 for General Reasoning, 413 for Natural Scene Reasoning, 232 for Physical Reasoning, and 91 for Logical Puzzle Reasoning. All bars are colored light blue and are not grouped or stacked. The chart does not contain any visually emphasized bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Proben auf verschiedene Arten von Denkvermögen. Die horizontale Achse enthält die Kategorien Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning und Chemical Reasoning, aufgelistet in dieser Reihenfolge ohne besondere Sortierung oder Hervorhebung. Die vertikale Achse ist mit "Number of Samples" beschriftet und hat eine Skala von 0 bis 10^4 mit regelmäßigen Markierungen im Abstand von 10^2. Die Balken sind einheitlich hellblau eingefärbt. Der höchste Balken, Mathematical Reasoning, erreicht ungefähr 7025 Proben, während der niedrigste Balken, Chemical Reasoning, bei etwa 49 Proben liegt. Zwischen diesen Extremen variieren die Balken für General Reasoning (1709), Natural Scene Reasoning (413), Physical Reasoning (232), Logical Puzzle Reasoning (91) und liegen damit auf deutlich niedrigerem Niveau als Mathematical Reasoning.
